posts.headline: Tip
posts.body:
Retinol stimulates collagen production faster than any other ingredient.
Start at 0.025% and work up slowly.
posts.cta: Retinol is the gold standard anti-aging ingredient.

posts.headline: Tip
posts.body:
Omega-3 fatty acids reduce triglycerides by up to 30%.
Aim for 2 servings of fatty fish per week.
posts.cta: Fatty fish 2x a week protects your heart.
